# [Company name] — Solar knowledge base

<!--
Starter template (Blueprint §3.4). Copy this into a Google Doc in the folder you
connected to Sunny, replace every [bracketed placeholder], and delete sections
you do not need. Sunny reads it automatically on the next sync.

How to write it so Sunny answers well:
- Keep the headings. Sunny splits the document at ## and ### headings, and each
  answer is quoted with the heading it came from.
- Keep tables as tables. A table is never split across passages, so a price
  stays next to its product.
- Write exact model numbers (e.g. "Enphase IQ8M", "REC420AA"): customers ask for
  them by name.
- Anything still in [brackets] or written as XXXX is reported to you as a
  placeholder and is never quoted to a customer.
- Never put customer documents (bills, contracts, signed forms) in this folder.
  They are detected and kept out of the index, but they should not be there.
-->
